question: Take accepted C4 resonators (level-1 units) with distinct collective rates and let them interact only through the unchanged C4 element law. Does a label-free detector reading only their ResonatorState find a level-2 resonator (persistent, recovering, frequency-locked, every unit alive and distinct), and does the level-2 mode depend causally on unit geometry and unit geometry on the level-2 mode, each effect vanishing under its complete matched ablation?

hypotheses.H-M_level2: geometry and modes influence one another at the unit scale (whole <-> parts)
hypotheses.H-C_first_transition: one composition step R0 -> R1 under the same rule, with a valid effective state and a coarse prediction that beats cheap baselines

not_tested: units co-forming from one primitive soup

level1.rule: fresh C4 identical-arm worlds with the frozen C4 code; accepted resonators within size_range become single-use templates, assigned to level-2 worlds in harvest order

normalization.rule: T = median tau2 / median tau1 on development worlds, rounded to 0.2 (step-exact), frozen; tau1: internal e-folding after an element phase kick, unit alone; tau2: e-folding of the inter-unit pattern after the unit-phase probe, intact G->M control
normalization.development_measurement: 10 development worlds (entropy 22222) run with provisional T = 2.6: tau1 median 1.5 over 50 units, tau2 median 4.94 over 4 accepted groups; ratio 3.29, rounded to the 0.2 grid -> 3.2

integration.note: C4 dt and RK4; the level-2 horizon, window and frame interval are the C4 values times T

detector.rule: C4 criteria 1-5 on unit states with the C4 thresholds (times x T, freq_tol / T); criterion 6: each member unit passes its own C4 criteria 2-4 with level-1 thresholds and its port overlap <= max_port_overlap
detector.max_port_overlap_basis: development worlds: accepted groups reach at most 0.167 (one of six ports touching), the merged candidate 0.4; units' 95th percentile 0.167

gm_ablations.no_geometry_to_mode: complete: w = 1 and phase topology frozen at s0 (primary)

effective_state_bounds.note: frequency bound is divided by T

statistics.unit: world (seed); its value is the mean over its accepted level-2 resonators

verdict_rules.formation_l2: PASS if fraction >= 0.5 and >= 10 worlds FORMED; FAIL otherwise
verdict_rules.causality: rows: (1) INCONCLUSIVE if < 10 formed worlds; (2) FAIL if the intact CI includes 0 or lies below it; (3) PASS if the complete ablation CI includes 0 or |mean| <= 0.2 x intact mean; (4) INCONCLUSIVE otherwise
verdict_rules.dose_response: per direction: (1) INCONCLUSIVE if < 10 worlds; (2) PASS if means non-decreasing and the highest-minus-lowest CI > 0; (3) FAIL if that CI < 0; (4) INCONCLUSIVE otherwise. Endpoint FAIL if either direction fails, PASS only if both pass
verdict_rules.margin_endpoints: downward_effect and emergent_transfer: (1) INCONCLUSIVE if < 10 worlds; (2) FAIL if the CI upper bound < 0.01 rad; (3) PASS if the CI lower bound > 0.01 rad; (4) INCONCLUSIVE otherwise
verdict_rules.effective_state_l2: (1) INCONCLUSIVE if < 10 formed worlds or no units; (2) PASS if >= 90% of accepted level-2 units meet every bound; (3) FAIL otherwise
verdict_rules.coarse_vs_full: paired per world, gain = baseline error - coarse error for each baseline: (1) INCONCLUSIVE if < 10 worlds; (2) FAIL if either gain CI upper bound < 0; (3) PASS if both gain CI lower bounds > 0; (4) INCONCLUSIVE otherwise
verdict_rules.controls: not_independent and not_a_clump_l2: FAIL if any imposed candidate is accepted; PASS if >= 1 tested and none accepted; NOT_TESTED if none. Gate: both PASS

H-M_level2: any of g_to_m_l2, m_to_g_l2, dose_response_l2 = FAIL
formation_l2 = PASS and all three = PASS
otherwise (formation FAIL; < 10 formed worlds; any INCONCLUSIVE)
H-C_first_transition: any of downward_effect, emergent_transfer, effective_state_l2, coarse_vs_full = FAIL
H-M_level2 = SUPPORTED_WITHIN_SCOPE and those four = PASS

numerical_checks.note: RK4 order, switching dt error and equivariance use the frozen C4 tolerances; unit relabelling uses the C4 equivariance tolerance

seeds.rule: final entropy drawn with secrets.randbits(63) at registration; final worlds (and their harvest worlds) are never simulated before the recorded panel; smoke and tests use development entropy

endpoints.level1_pool: harvest counts and sizes; every used unit, alone with its rate, is re-detected as an accepted C4 resonator (gate)
endpoints.formation_l2: fraction of final worlds FORMED, Wilson 95% CI; PASS at >= 0.5 with >= 10 worlds
endpoints.formation_outcomes: descriptive: FORMED / MERGED / DRIFTING / APART / OTHER and per-criterion candidate failures
endpoints.formation_vs_spread: descriptive: formation with every rate scaled by 0.5, 1.0 and 2.0
endpoints.not_independent: decoupled continuation with the assembled rates, imposed candidates; must reject all (gate)
endpoints.not_a_clump_l2: decoupled continuation with all rates 0, imposed candidates; must reject all (gate)
endpoints.g_to_m_l2: G->M paired effect (intact, s = 1.25) and the complete ablation; causality rule
endpoints.m_to_g_l2: M->G paired effect (intact, uniform unit phases) and J = 0; causality rule
endpoints.dose_response_l2: G->M over s = 1.1/1.25/1.5 and M->G over RMS 0.5/1.0/uniform; dose rule
endpoints.g_to_m_channels_l2: descriptive: single-channel G->M effects as a fraction of intact
endpoints.parts_alive: descriptive: criterion-6 values for every unit of every candidate
endpoints.downward_effect: port-member phase-offset shift, group versus the same units alone; margin rule; entrainment reported
endpoints.emergent_transfer: response of the other units to a phase pulse on one unit, intact minus decoupled; margin rule
endpoints.effective_state_l2: >= 90% of accepted level-2 units within the effective-state bounds
endpoints.coarse_vs_full: coarse law (ports, zero fitted parameters, reopening) against no-transfer and rigid-transfer baselines on held-out excitations; frequency error, recovery error, reopen rate and work reported
endpoints.same_rule_audit: level-2 thresholds equal C4's after the single factor T; T, tau1, tau2 and the final-world measured ratio recorded (gate)
endpoints.numerical_checks: RK4 order, switching dt error, equivariance, unit relabelling and exact decoupling on an assembled world (gate)

gates: passing focused contracts for the exact dependency fingerprint
complete panel for every final world
source hashes stable during the run
registered_changes_from_proposal: Criterion 6 distinctness uses port overlap (fraction of a unit's ports strictly inside another unit's hull <= 0.2) instead of the own-neighbour fraction q. Development worlds: the own-neighbour fraction falls to 0.5-0.6 for units merely pressed together (it measures contact area), while member hull overlap stays 0 except in a merged candidate.
The unit phase Theta is the circular mean of member phases, unwrapped over frames: C4 keeps member phases unwrapped and they can differ by whole turns (all harvested units have coherence 1.00).

The coarse law is evaluated on port pairs with actual port distances and port phase offsets (the C4 law exactly) instead of centroid distances divided by L_I + L_J, which would add an unmeasured distance scale. A port's coupling capacity is its own-neighbour distance list from the level-1 owner.

Coarse reopening: a state is INVALID when a unit's cross-link count changes by more than half or an inter-unit phase difference moves by more than pi/2 (outside the sine locking basin). The proposal's 'leaves the lock tolerance' would fire on every 0.5 rad pulse by design.

Decoupling translates each unit 100 length units apart in the same world (beyond the C4 radius 3) instead of separate worlds: exact by translation equivariance, checked in numerical_checks against each unit simulated alone.
Primary doses: G->M s = 1.25 (the middle dose, as C4's primary was its middle scale); M->G 'uniform' (as C4). Uniform is a random rigid offset per unit.

Held-out excitations: one unit per group, chosen with the seeded rng; the response error is the RMS wrapped phase error plus the RMS position error over L, over the other group units and the 10 T window; the world value is the mean of the two excitations' gains.
T is rounded to a 0.2 grid so every scaled time is a whole number of RK4 steps.
Work is counted as pair evaluations for both models (full: N^2 neighbour search plus 4 RK4 stages over N x k; coarse: 5 P^2 over ports).
Harvest: ceil(1.3 x units needed) fresh C4 worlds; templates assigned to level-2 worlds in harvest order (world index, then detection order).
level1_pool re-detection: the frozen C4 detector on the assembled world with units decoupled, over the C4 window; every unit must equal an accepted component.
DRIFTING includes worlds with contact but no locked candidate group.

tau2 is the e-folding time of the inter-unit pattern after the unit-phase probe in the intact G->M control (no extra runs); tau1 uses a decoupled continuation with an element-level kick inside every unit.

Development settings from the design gate (tools/c5_design_gate.py, development entropy only): placement radius R2 = 2.5, rate half-width delta = 0.03 (median |d omega| x window = 0.586 x 0.03 x 96 = 1.7 rad >= 1 rad, the non-vacuity bound), min_gap 0.6.
Downward effect (b) uses each unit's ports (hull members) at s0 and compares phase offsets at the end of the 10 T window (group versus decoupled).

development_summary.note: settings only; development outcomes are not evidence. Formation 4/10 is below the registered 0.5; nothing was tuned to change it
